title: Never Enough
supportedClaims: The hardest part of money is often deciding what counts as enough before appetite turns success into self-destruction.
The chapter shows how status competition and changing baselines keep pulling the finish line farther away even after basic needs are long met.
The practical lesson is to define stop conditions, values, and tradeoffs before desire escalates faster than judgment.
caution: Enough is personal, but leaving it undefined invites outside status games to define it for you.
